CAPABILITY_REQUIRED.zh: 这台设备没有权限做这项操作
CAPABILITY_REQUIRED.en: This device isn't allowed to do this

CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_REQUIRED.zh: 需要经加密连接出示设备证书
CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_REQUIRED.en: Present the device certificate over an encrypted connection

DEVICE_CERTIFICATE_BOUND.zh: 这台设备已登记了另一张证书，请重新配对
DEVICE_CERTIFICATE_BOUND.en: This device is bound to another certificate. Pair it again

DEVICE_CERTIFICATE_REQUIRED.zh: 这台设备需要用自己的证书经加密连接登录，请更新 App 或重新配对
DEVICE_CERTIFICATE_REQUIRED.en: This device signs in with its own certificate over an encrypted connection. Update the app or pair it again

INSECURE_CONNECTION_READ_ONLY.zh: 连接未加密，只能查看。请用 App、本机网页或 HTTPS 地址操作
INSECURE_CONNECTION_READ_ONLY.en: This connection isn't encrypted, so it can only read. Use the app, this computer's own page, or an HTTPS address
